rules.title: Channel comes from the campaign type, not the name
rules.how: Where the export includes campaign type, that decides the channel. Names only suggest a likely purpose (brand, generic, competitor, dynamic), with a confidence level, and uncertain campaigns are left unclassified rather than guessed.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About the channel performance report for Performance Max

rules.title: Brand and non-brand are compared separately, without assuming brand is non-incremental
rules.how: Brand-named Search campaigns are only treated as brand if their results look like brand. Non-brand campaigns are compared with comparable non-brand activity, not the account average.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Apply brand exclusions to Performance Max or Search campaigns

rules.title: Lost impression share is only read for Search and Shopping
rules.how: Search lost IS (budget) and (rank) are used only for Search and Shopping campaigns. Across daily rows they're combined using impressions and impression share, and flagged as approximate if that isn't possible. Lost impression share is a prompt to look closer, not a measure of lost revenue.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Get impression share data
Google Ads Help: About impression share

rules.title: Returns are reported figures, calculated from totals
rules.how: ROAS is total conversion value divided by total spend and CPA is total spend divided by total conversions, never an average of ratios. They're Google's or Microsoft's reported figures, not verified profit.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Tips on measuring Smart Bidding performance

rules.title: Thin data is read with caution
rules.how: Campaigns with few conversions in the period carry less weight, and trends are only reported when both halves of the period have enough conversions.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About Smart Bidding learning

rules.title: Performance Max isn't like-for-like with Search
rules.how: Performance Max blends channels and can include brand searches, so its results are compared with care and its audience intent isn't inferred from its name.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About the search terms report in Performance Max

rules.title: Search terms show where spend actually goes
rules.how: With a search terms report, the X-ray looks at the share of spend reaching searches that never converted and how conversational searches have become.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Get negative keyword ideas using the search terms report
Google Ads Help: About ads in AI Overviews and AI Mode

rules.title: Only the strongest three or four observations are shown
rules.how: Every possible observation is scored on how much money is involved, how big the difference is, how solid the evidence is and how distinctive it is, and near-duplicates are dropped. If nothing stands out, it says so.
